purpose: Run the first untouched target-level transfer pilot after CDK2 and MAPK14 using the frozen pair-synergy QUBO workflow, without retuning on MAPK14 Stage 11.

prior_target_boundary.CDK2: consumed historical development and released locked-test evidence; not an independent target
prior_target_boundary.MAPK14: consumed Stage 09 development and Stage 11 fresh-validation evidence; frozen application proof of concept
prior_target_boundary.EGFR: new target; no EGFR docking score, enrichment metric, receptor subset, or QUBO coefficient has been used for this pilot

data_boundary.fresh_validation: not yet sampled; locked until the EGFR train-only method is frozen
data_boundary.test: not yet sampled; locked and unauthorized

ligand_panel_plan.internal_id_rule: EGFR label plus source line number; preserve the possibly duplicated DUD-E source ID as metadata
ligand_panel_plan.allocation_rule: deterministic scaffold-group allocation with no molecule, canonical-SMILES, source-line, or scaffold overlap among train, fresh validation, and test
ligand_panel_plan.failure_action: stop before ligand preparation if exact disjoint panel sizes cannot be constructed

receptor_pool_plan.coordinate_gate: proper-rotation alignment to 2RGP chain A, complete reference ATP-pocket anchors, and a noncovalent drug-like ligand within 6 A of the reference ATP pocket
receptor_pool_plan.selection_rule: label-independent deterministic max-min selection over pocket C-alpha and side-chain-centroid distance features
receptor_pool_plan.failure_action: exclude failed structures without relaxing the gate; stop if fewer than 16 receptors remain

method_transfer.primary_aggregation: median across seeds, then min_score across selected receptors
method_transfer.stage12a_v2_policy: do not promote the provisional v2; Stage 12A selected the same MAPK14 subset and failed its development support rule

authorized_now: coordinate download and label-independent structural audit

interpretation_boundary: EGFR is the first new target-level pilot after the MAPK14 result. Success can support portability of the frozen QUBO application workflow; one additional kinase cannot establish broad cross-class generality, QUBO superiority, or quantum advantage.
